intro.h2: Stone shop and install crew in one
paragraphs: VL Granite & Marble cuts and installs granite countertops in Sheridan and nearby Colorado towns, along with quartz, quartzite and marble. The shop at 1865 W Union Ave fabricates the stone, and the same team sets it in your kitchen, bathroom or bar.

Customers keep naming Victor, both Sr. and Jr. One couple hired VL for their kitchen, liked the work so much they added their bathrooms, then watched the crew turn a cut-out remnant into extra backsplash on site. When the wrong size sink held up their island, the team offered to drive more than an hour up the mountain on a Friday night to finish it.

items.name: Kitchen countertops
items.blurb: Granite, quartz, quartzite and marble cut to your cabinets and installed with care. Reviewers say the crew watched out for their new cabinets during install, explained what they needed to know about the stone, and left everything cleaned up.

image.alt: White quartz countertop with gray veining and undermount sink in a kitchen with white cabinets

items.name: Bathroom vanity tops
items.blurb: The same slabs work beautifully in a bathroom. One customer first hired VL for kitchen countertops and then asked Victor to extend the job to their bathrooms. VL recommends quartzite such as Crystallo for countertops and vanities alike.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a finished bathroom in a Colorado foothills home: a white quartzite vanity top with soft gray veining and an undermount sink on a dark walnut vanity, matching stone backsplash, matte black faucet, light gray walls, a window showing pine trees, soft natural daylight, crisp and uncluttered with subtle cool violet-gray tones; no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names. Aspect ratio 4:3.
image.alt: Illustration: bathroom vanity with a white veined quartzite top and undermount sink

items.name: Waterfall islands and full-height backsplashes
items.blurb: Bold slabs look best when the veining carries on. VL runs stone down the sides of islands and up the wall as full-height backsplashes, with matching niches cut into the slab, as in the boldly veined kitchen shown here.

image.alt: White quartz with bold gray veining running from countertop up a full-height backsplash with two niches

items.name: Bars and commercial tops
items.blurb: Beyond homes, VL has cut stone for bars and commercial spaces, including a backlit stone bar and wall panels at Columbine Ranch in Sedalia, Colorado, and long white bar tops set on carved wood bar cabinets.

image.alt: Backlit translucent stone bar top and wall columns at Columbine Ranch, Sedalia, Colorado

items.name: Kitchen remodels and demolition
items.blurb: Need the old tops torn out first? VL lists kitchen remodeling and demolition alongside countertops and shares before and after kitchen remodels on Facebook, so you can have the old surfaces removed and new stone set by one crew.

image.alt: Kitchen with new white quartz countertop and undermount sink beside stainless refrigerator

why_choose_us.h2: Why homeowners choose VL Granite & Marble

items.title: 17 years working with stone
items.text: VL says it brings 17 years of industry experience to every job and specializes in fabricating and installing, with responsibility, honesty and loyalty as its stated values.

items.title: Careful, clean installs
items.text: Six Google reviews mention a clean job. One family noted the crew took care not to damage their new cabinets and left with everything cleaned up.

items.title: Creative on site
items.text: Instead of wasting the sink cut-out, the installers suggested using that remnant to extend a customer's backsplash. Ideas like that are why one reviewer called Victor creative as well as professional.

items.title: Fair pricing, real value
items.text: Reviewers describe the pricing as very fair and the work as great value. VL Granite & Marble also offers free estimates, so you know the cost before you commit.

about.text: VL Granite & Marble LLC is a stone fabrication and installation company in Sheridan, Colorado, with 17 years of industry experience behind it. In its own words, it works with responsibility, honesty and loyalty and concentrates on bringing only the best to its clients. One customer describes Victor Sr. and Victor Jr. finding the perfect materials and working after hours and on weekends to fit their schedule. The company is accredited by the Better Business Bureau, something it says it is very honored to have.

image.alt: VL installer working at the sink cut-out of a white quartz waterfall island during installation

steps.title: Free estimate
steps.text: Call (303) 591-7523 or email to schedule your free estimate. Reviewers say the process was smooth from the very first booking.

steps.title: Choose your stone
steps.text: Pick your slab from granite, quartz, quartzite or marble. Victor helps you find the right material, as one customer did with Crystallo quartzite.

steps.title: Fabrication
steps.text: The stone is cut and finished for your layout, including sink cut-outs, waterfall edges, backsplashes and niches.

steps.title: Installation and clean up
steps.text: The crew sets the tops, takes care around your cabinets, explains how to look after your stone and leaves everything cleaned up.

items.name: Cesar S.
items.text: Victor and his crew were amazing to work with. They were polite, professional, and made the entire process smooth—from scheduling the estimate to delivery and installation. The quality of work was excellent, and the pricing was very fair. I would highly recommend VL Granite to anyone looking for high-quality craftsmanship and great value.

items.name: Angie N.
items.text: Victor and his team were amazing to work with. They were very professional and knowledgeable. You could tell that they wanted to provide quality work. When installing they were very cognizant of our kitchen remodel and not damaging cabinets. They left after installation with everything cleaned up. They were very kind and courteous while here. The whole team was able to provide information that we needed to know about our new countertops. They are amazing and beautiful! I will definitely use them again in the future.

items.name: Deb S.
items.text:
We're without words.... We’re absolutely thrilled with every aspect of our project with VL Granite & Marble LLC!!
From the initial countertop selection stage, (working with Izzet who supplied premium Crystallo quartzite slabs), through final installation, Victor was extremely responsive, professional, creative & a joy to work with!!
We initially contracted VL Granite & Marble (based on great reviews), for our kitchen countertop fabrication & installation.  But Victor was so amazing, we requested he extend the scope to our bathrooms.  Victor (both Jr. & Sr.), worked tirelessly on our requests (from finding the perfect materials to working after hours/weekends to accommodate our schedule).
The VL Granite & Marble installation team was conscientious, professional & detail oriented.  In addition, they proactively suggested a creative way to use a cut out remnant to extend our backsplash while on site.   If this wasn't enough, when post fabrication it was clear my husband had ordered the wrong size sink, Victor & team went way above & beyond.  They offered to return the next night (after working all day on their scheduled job, driving an extra hour + up the mountain on a Friday night), to install our kitchen island after the cabinet company made the necessary adjustments.
All in all, we couldn't be happier with their brilliant team, the overall project experience, their craftsmanship & the awesome results of our new kitchen countertops!!

service_area.h2: Granite countertops in Sheridan and beyond
service_area.text: VL Granite & Marble works from 1865 W Union Ave, Suite J, in Sheridan, Colorado. Past projects include a kitchen in Morrison and a backlit stone bar at Columbine Ranch in Sedalia, and one couple's island took the crew up into the mountains. If you are in the Denver area or the foothills, call (303) 591-7523 and ask about your address.

items.q: What materials do you work with?
items.a: Granite, marble, quartz and quartzite. Our Facebook posts feature Crystallo quartzite, Virgo granite and Mysterio Brown white quartz, and the photos on this page include white quartz kitchens and a black and white granite waterfall bar. Bring us your ideas and we will talk through the options.

Yes. VL Granite & Marble offers free estimates. Call (303) 591-7523 during business hours or email vlgraniteandmarble9@gmail.com with your layout or a few photos of the space, and we will set up a time to measure and talk through your stone choices.

items.q: Do you do bathrooms as well as kitchens?
items.a: Yes. Besides kitchen countertops, we cut and install bathroom vanity tops. One customer hired us for kitchen countertop fabrication and installation and then asked Victor to extend the work to their bathrooms. We also do bar tops, backsplashes and waterfall islands.

The shop is in Sheridan, Colorado, at 1865 W Union Ave, Suite J. Past projects include a kitchen in Morrison and a stone bar at Columbine Ranch in Sedalia. If you live elsewhere in the Denver area or up in the foothills, call (303) 591-7523 to ask whether your address is covered.

We are open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. One reviewer did mention that Victor worked after hours and on weekends to fit their schedule, so if your timing is tight, ask us.

final_cta.text: Book a free estimate and pick your slab with Victor and the VL Granite & Marble team.
